# 0.9.0-alpha04

> **Alpha, checked on an emulator only.** Unit tests pass. Search, search by image, watch order and the theme colours were looked at on an emulator in several themes; nothing in this build has been on a real phone yet. Expect bugs and report them on GitHub.
>
> Version `0.9.0-alpha04` (`1900004`). Installs as **Editotsu α** (`ani.editotsu.beta`) and updates alpha03 in place.

- **New Features:**
  - Search redone
    - Filters are chips under the search bar: type, sort, genres, format, status, year, season, list, tags, exclude, source and country; each opens a sheet
    - Tapping a genre tile filters right there
    - The search button on home asks what to search for (anime, manga, characters, staff, studios, users)
  - Search by image redone
    - Your picture on top, then one card per likely episode with the time and match
    - Weaker guesses as small rows under "Probably not it"
  - Watch order: finished entries show a check and "Completed" above the title

- **Bugfixes:**
  - Sheets, menus, calendar and list rows were lilac in every theme; they now follow the theme you picked, and stay visible on OLED
  - Monochrome: the selected option in a sheet and the settings cards blended into the background
  - Media page tags, synonyms and links are bold again with an outline in the theme colour
  - Chips use Material 3 sizes; the dropdown arrow is no longer a separate button with its own ripple
  - Sync lists: the swap button is a round button; rows spell out status, progress and score

- **Known issues:**
  - Pink light theme: the main colour is too pale, so white text on buttons and the chip outlines are hard to read
